plain_english_policy: This bill directs the transfer of specific funds from a dedicated trust to the state's general budget. Specifically, it moves money that was previously set aside for the State Board of Education into the General Fund.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would reclassify funding sources by moving receipts allocated to the Children First Trust Fund (specifically those designated for the State Board of Education) directly into the State General Fund. This action effectively removes that specific portion of revenue from its restricted trust status and makes it available for general state expenditures during fiscal year 2011.
sponsorship_supports_position: The bill is sponsored by Representatives Lindsey, Gipson, Bentley, Buskey, Kennedy, Greeson, Oden, Taylor, Letson, Hinshaw, Rogers, Fields and Graham.
evidence_quotes: (a) Notwithstanding any provision of Division 1 of Article 17 of Chapter 10 of Title 41, Code of Alabama 1975, any provision of Chapter 15B of Title 41, Code of Alabama 1975, or any other provision of law, that portion of Children First Trust Fund receipts currently allocated for the State Board of Education shall be transferred from the Children First Trust Fund to the State General Fund during the fiscal year ending September 30, 2011.
To provide for transfer to the State General Fund during fiscal year 2011 that portion of Children First Trust Fund receipts currently allocated for the State Board of Education.
